description: Click an element on the webpage by its snapshot ref (e.g. "@e12"), numeric index, or CSS selector.

index.description: The numeric index of the interactive element from the snapshot (mapped to ref "@e<index>").

ref.description: Element reference from browser_snapshot (e.g. "@e12"). Preferred over index; also used to target a scroll container.

selector.description: Alternative CSS selector of the element to click.

tabId.description: Optional browser tab id to act on instead of the focused tab.

name: browser_click
